questions.question: In an office, the average salary of 22 staff members was ₹81,400. If the average salary of staff and the Vice Chairman was ₹89,600, then how much is the salary of the Vice Chairman (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average salary of 22 staff members = ₹81,400

Total staff members including Vice Chairman = 22 + 1 = 23

Average salary of 23 members = ₹89,600

**Formula Used:**

Total Salary = Average Salary x Number of Members

**Calculation:**

Total salary of 22 staff members = 81,400 x 22

Total salary of 22 staff members = 1,790,800

Total salary of 23 members = 89,600 x 23

Total salary of 23 members = 2,060,800

Salary of Vice Chairman = Total salary of 23 members - Total salary of 22 staff members

Salary of Vice Chairman = 2,060,800 - 1,790,800

Salary of Vice Chairman = 270,000

**The salary of the Vice Chairman is ₹2,70,000.**

questions.question: The average weight of a family of five members (in kg) whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 72 kg and 36 kg is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weights of the family members: 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 72 kg, 36 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average weight = Total weight of all members / Number of members

**Calculation:**

Total weight of all members = 40 + 49 + 56 + 72 + 36

Total weight = 253 kg

Number of members = 5

Average weight = Total weight / Number of members

⇒ Average weight = 253 / 5

⇒ Average weight = 50.6 kg

**The average weight of the family is 50.6 kg.**

questions.question: Anand wanted to make a cylindrical kaleidoscope of length 30 cm and radius 7 cm. If he is using handmade sheets to make it, then how much sheet will be required for this?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cylindrical kaleidoscope (height) = 30 cm

Radius of the cylindrical kaleidoscope = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of the cylindrical kaleidoscope = Curved Surface Area (CSA)

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

Height (h) = 30 cm

Radius (r) = 7 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

CSA = 2 × π × 7 × 30

CSA = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × 30

CSA = 1320 cm²

**The total sheet required will be 1320 cm².**

questions.question: A and B start running simultaneously, around a circular track of 1200 m, in the same direction, at a speed of 8 m/s and 12 m/s, respectively. A and B will meet at the starting point for the first time after:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the circular track = 1200 m

Speed of A = 8 m/s

Speed of B = 12 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time taken to meet at the starting point = Length of the track / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed when running in the same direction = 12 m/s - 8 m/s

Relative speed = 4 m/s

Time taken to meet at the starting point

⇒ Time = Length of the track / Relative speed

⇒ Time = 1200 m / 4 m/s

⇒ Time = 300 s

**A and B will meet at the starting point for the first time after 300 seconds.**

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4000 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate of interest (r) = 4% per annum

Time (t) = 6 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × r × t) / 100

**Calculations:**

SI = (4000 × 4 × 6) / 100

SI = (96000) / 100

SI = ₹960

**Therefore, the simple interest is ₹960.**

questions.question: In an election, 750 votes were cast for the two contestants, Bharti and Manya. Bharti defeated Manya by 16% votes. If there were no invalid vote, then how many votes did Manya get?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total votes = 750

Bharti defeated Manya by 16% votes.

**Calculation:**

Let the number of votes Manya received be x.

Then, the number of votes Bharti received is (750 - x).

Since Bharti defeated Manya by 16% of the total votes, we have the equation:

(Votes of Bharti) = (Votes of Manya) + 16% of total votes

750 - x = x + (16/100) × 750

750 - x = x + 120

Now, solve for x:

750 - 120 = 2x

630 = 2x

x = 630 / 2

x = 315

**Therefore, Manya received 315 votes.**

questions.question: In a class, there are 30 boys and 20 girls. The average score of boys in Physics is 92, whereas the average score of girls in Physics is 83. Find the average score of the whole class in Physics.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of boys = 30

Number of girls = 20

Average score of boys = 92

Average score of girls = 83

**Formula used:**

Average score of the whole class = (Total score of boys + Total score of girls) / Total number of students

**Calculation:**

Total score of boys = Number of boys × Average score of boys = 30 × 92 = 2760

Total score of girls = Number of girls × Average score of girls = 20 × 83 = 1660

Total score of the class = Total score of boys + Total score of girls = 2760 + 1660 = 4420

Total number of students = Number of boys + Number of girls = 30 + 20 = 50

Average score of the class = Total score of the class / Total number of students = 4420 / 50 = 88.4

**Therefore, the average score of the whole class in Physics is 88.4.**

questions.question: Find the HCF of 36 and 84.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

We need to find the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 36 and 84.

**Concept used:**

We will use the prime factorization method to find the HCF.

**Calculation:**

36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = 2² × 3²

84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 = 2² × 3 × 7

The common prime factors are 2² and 3.

HCF = 2² × 3 = 4 × 3 = 12

**Therefore, the HCF of 36 and 84 is 12.**

questions.question: A thief is running away on a straight road on a bike moving at the speed of 28 m/s. A policeman chases him in a car moving at the speed of 30 m/s. If the instantaneous separation of the bike from the car is 400 m, how long will it take for the policeman to catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the thief's bike = 28 m/s

Speed of the policeman's car = 30 m/s

Initial separation between the thief and the policeman = 400 m

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed = Speed of the policeman's car - Speed of the thief's bike

Time = Distance / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 30 m/s - 28 m/s

Relative speed = 2 m/s

Time = Distance / Relative speed

Time = 400 m / 2 m/s

Time = 200 seconds

**The time it will take for the policeman to catch the thief is 200 seconds.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers buy three, get one free; what is the percentage discount being offered by the shopkeeper in this scheme?
questions.solution:

A shopkeeper offers a "buy three, get one free" scheme.

Percentage Discount = (1 / 4) × 100

questions.question: In a lead pipe 4.2 m long, the external diameter is 5.4 cm and the thickness of the pipe is 3 mm. Find the weight of the pipe, if 1 cm³ of lead mass is 25 grams. (Use π = 22/7 )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all units to cm: Length (h) = 420 cm, R = 2.7 cm, r = (2.7 − 0.3) = 2.4 cm.

Using Volume of Hollow Cylinder = π × (R + r) × (R − r) × h

Volume = (22/7) × (2.7 + 2.4) × (2.7 − 2.4) × 420 = 22 × 60 × 5.1 × 0.3 = 2019.6 cm³.

Weight = (Volume × Density) / 1000 = (2019.6 × 25) / 1000 = 2019.6 / 40 = 50.49 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 50.49 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of pipe (h) = 4.2 m = 420 cm

External diameter (D) = 5.4 cm ⇒ External radius (R) = 2.7 cm

Thickness (t) = 3 mm = 0.3 cm

Density of lead = 25 g/cm³

Internal radius (r) = R − t = 2.7 − 0.3 = 2.4 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acd11433b61d52139dfb89287e725fa4bfad684b71948d7f64c4ce6983a7141a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of material in a hollow cylinder = πh(R² − r²)

Total Weight = Volume × Density

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 420 × (2.7² − 2.4²)

⇒ Volume = 22 × 60 × (7.29 − 5.76)

⇒ Volume = 1320 × 1.53

⇒ Volume = 2019.6 cm³

⇒ Weight of pipe in grams = 2019.6 × 25 = 50490 g

⇒ Weight in kg = 50490 / 1000 = 50.49 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 50.49 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Hollow Cylinder

It is the difference between the volumes of the outer and inner cylinders: V = πR²h − πr²h = πh(R² − r²).

Total Surface Area of Hollow Cylinder

TSA = Outer CSA + Inner CSA + 2 × Area of Base Ring = 2πRh + 2πrh + 2π(R² − r²).

Mass and Density Relation

Mass = Volume × Density. Ensure all dimensions are in the same unit system before calculating (e.g., cm and g/cm³).</p

questions.question: In a school sports camp, there is food provision for 200 students for 30 days. If 50 more persons join the sports camp on the 2nd day, for how many days will the provision last?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Food provision = for 200 students × 30 days

On 2nd day, 50 more join → total = 250 students from day 2

**Formula used:**

Total food = Total persons × Total days

Remaining food = Initial food - food consumed on day 1

New duration = Remaining food ÷ New total persons

**Calculation:**

Total food = 200 × 30 = 6000 person-days

Food consumed on day 1 = 200 × 1 = 200

Remaining food = 6000 - 200 = 5800 person-days

From day 2, persons = 250

⇒ Remaining days = 5800 ÷ 250 = 23.2 days

Total days = 1 (already passed) + 23.2 = 24.2 days

**∴ The provision will last for approximately 24 days.**
